articles.title: After BrahMos, India may have found its next military bestseller
articles.summary: India's defence export narrative is largely shaped by the BrahMos supersonic cruise missile, which has emerged as the country's flagship military export. This advanced weapon has successfully attracted international buyers, underscoring India's growing capabilities and ambition in the global defence market. It marks a significant shift in India's role from importer to a credible arms exporter.

articles.title: Peter, Paul and Mary’s Noel Stookey Had a Front Row Seat to the Sixties. He Remembers All of It
articles.summary: Rolling Stone magazine launched 'Last Man Standing,' an interview series where senior writer Andy Greene engages in long-form conversations with the final surviving members of iconic bands. This initiative offers unique insights into their legacies and personal experiences, preserving the history of influential music groups through in-depth discussions.

articles.title: Turning Latin America’s Resilience Into Growth
articles.summary: Latin America and the Caribbean have achieved significant economic stabilization, marking a major milestone for a region historically plagued by frequent financial crises. This positive development, highlighted by experts like Ilan Goldfajn and Eduardo Levy Yeyati, signifies a substantial shift towards greater economic resilience and stability across the area, offering a promising outlook for its future economic landscape after a long period of challenges.

articles.title: This Date in Washington Senators History – ’33 Senators climb into 1st place
articles.summary: This article chronicles historical baseball events occurring on June 23rd. It details controversial figure Hal Chase's 1911 achievement of setting a Major League record with 21 putouts as a first baseman, during a game where the Highlanders narrowly defeated the Nats 3-2 in Washington. The text also references Walter Johnson, indicating a broader focus on significant past moments and legendary players in American baseball history.
